## /rebar-debug — final report (CLOSED)

**Proven survivor (by execution).** `run_sweep` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py:169`) resolves its code root at line 233 `repo_root = _cfg.repo_root_or_none()` and hands it to `compact_all_cli([], repo_root=repo_root)` (line 242). The FALLBACK arm (`REBAR_ROOT` unset → git-toplevel of the detached child's anchored cwd) was covered only by the end-to-end `test_run_sweep_resolves_the_code_root_without_rebar_root`, which asserts a snapshot appears. Mutating line 233 to `repo_root = None` left that test **GREEN (exit 0)** — the survivor — because with cwd inside the checkout `compact_all_cli` re-discovers the same root and folds by accident. `repo_root = os.path.dirname(tracker)` was already killed. The REBAR_ROOT arm had a seam test; the fallback arm did not.

**Behavior pinned.** New seam test `test_run_sweep_seam_pins_the_resolved_code_root_on_the_fallback_arm` records the `repo_root` value `run_sweep` hands `compact_all_cli` and asserts it equals the resolved code root — never `None`, never `os.path.dirname(tracker)`. It runs over a REAL worktree-symlink topology (ephemeral worktree whose `.tickets-tracker` symlinks a co-located canonical store) anchored by the real `_proc.detached_child_cwd`. The symlink is load-bearing: `dirname(worktree/.tickets-tracker)` is the ephemeral worktree, distinct from the realpath-resolved canonical parent (the code root) — that separation is what makes the `dirname(tracker)` mutant killable on this arm; a mock or co-located dir cannot distinguish the arms.

**RED→GREEN path (sandbox-exec, macOS; no `timeout` binary).**
- `repo_root=None` mutant → seam test RED (`assert None is not None`, right reason).
- `repo_root=os.path.dirname(tracker)` mutant → seam test RED (dirname ≠ realpath'd code root discriminator).
- Clean code → GREEN. Full affected suites: 90 passed; ruff + mypy clean.

**caused_by.** `6bf1-326b-7404-4034` (`scathing-custommade-bobcat`), commit `c68cc1de3185`, which introduced BOTH the fallback arm and its e2e-only test — a plan/test-design omission (hence `--class=plan_defect`). The weak e2e test is **retained deliberately** as the fold-effect contrast (reason recorded in its docstring), not deleted.

**Siblings (Step 7).** Swept the sweep/metrics detached-child constructs. `enrich_drain`/`gc_trigger` detached children use a different shape (pass `None`/argv; downstream discovers the root) — not siblings of this seam construct; their anchors are covered by `test_detached_child_cwd.py`. No unfixed siblings.

**Legitimacy / portability.** `incomplete-implementation` / test-gap: production `repo_root_or_none()` is correct — the change is TEST-ONLY, no production behavior altered (no escalation needed). The fallback is exactly the `project.portability` concern (a sweep that works with no CI provider / `REBAR_ROOT` unset in a local checkout), so it MUST stay functional — now pinned.

**Landing.** Gerrit change [2393](https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2393): `LLM-Review +1` (PASS) + `Verified +1` (CI success) + 0 unresolved → submitted as `27d7c35c9047` (rebar-ticket trailer `a027-d86c-8a00-407c`, DCO signed). Closed via completion-verifier gate (PASS) with `--class=plan_defect --caused-by=6bf1-326b-7404-4034`.
